fusions.name: Fault Line
fusions.desc: Heaves up strata in sheets across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 15 damage to every enemy in it and stunning each for 0.8 seconds. Every enemy hit is [Exposed] for 6 seconds, stripping its resistance to the elements.

fusions.name: Shattered Tablet
fusions.desc: Hurls an inscribed clay tablet into the first enemy it meets for 34 damage. It shatters there, dealing 80% of that damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Set in Stone
fusions.desc: The damage you take is reduced by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Milestone Script
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
